audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats a landed Bear Trap as terminal — "one lockdown turns the deer into a kill notification". Riot's text says the trap shackles and only yanks you in if you are STILL shackled after a short duration. Lillia's answer to that is the one thing she always has: Blooming Blows grants stacking Move Speed on every spell hit, so sprinting out breaks the leash before the pull. Nothing on the page tells the player this.
audit.why: It converts the matchup's scariest moment from a death sentence into a race the champion is built to win, and it is stated directly in both kits.
audit.corrected: tldr, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now say to spend Q move speed on distance the instant the trap lands, because the shackle only yanks if you stay close.
sources: enemyKit Q text "If shackled for a short duration... is yanked toward Kled"
ownerKit Q text "gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells"
